title: The $210 Billion Chip Shortage Exposed One Weak Link
hook: A $210 billion shortage revealed how concentrated chip production became.
closing: Your next car can stall when one concentrated chip supply chain breaks.
question: Did chip shortages delay your purchase?

segments.say: TSMC makes 90 percent of the most advanced chips. One dominant producer makes every disruption spread farther.
Chip lead times reached 27 weeks. Carmakers waited roughly half a year for tiny parts.
The projected auto loss rose to 210 billion dollars. The shortage became almost twice as costly as first forecast.
